items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The CTE structure is clear, but several names are cryptic: CTEs `agg` and `top`, count column `c`, aliases `a`/`t`. `c` is the core count in the logic. Layout is a bit dense, e.g. multiple columns per line in the final SELECT.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Two small CTEs, each with one job: per-word aggregates, then a ROW_NUMBER pick of the top synset. No repeated subqueries and no dead code. The ORDER BY appears twice, but that is needed because LIMIT is pushed into the CTE.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A single declarative query. Its only constants (thresholds >= 2, LIMIT 500) come from the original query. The LEFT JOIN on `rn = 1` still returns every word even if no top synset is found. No hidden error paths.

items.name: Semantically equivalent, not just equal on this data
items.name_zh: 语义等价而非仅在当前数据上相等
items.evidence: Keeps the HAVING thresholds and COUNT(DISTINCT) logic. Moving LIMIT 500 into the CTE is safe because it uses the same full ORDER BY, ending in wordid ASC. Top-synset tie-break `c DESC, synsetid ASC` is kept. No constants taken from the data; output checksum matches the original.
